title: Efficient Security Evaluation for Distinct GIFT-64 Mappings
summary: The construction uses one common mapping across state columns, while efficient evaluation of differential and linear security for distinct column mappings remains open.

formal_statement.body: For GIFT-64-like ciphers, whose construction applies one identical 16-bit group mapping to every state column, develop an efficient method for evaluating differential and linear security when distinct 16-bit group mappings are applied to different state columns.

scope.domain: Symmetric block-cipher design and differential and linear cryptanalysis of GIFT-64-like constructions.
parameters: 16-bit group mappings: mappings applied to state columns
state columns: positions to which the mappings are applied
scope.unresolved_remainder: Develop an efficient method for evaluating differential and linear security when distinct 16-bit group mappings are applied to different state columns.

citations.label: A Greater GIFT: Strengthening GIFT against Statistical Cryptanalysis

progress.summary: The paper describes a GIFT-64-like construction using the same 16-bit group mapping for every state column. It explicitly identifies efficient evaluation with distinct mappings across columns as an open problem.
citation_labels: Ling Sun et al., A Greater GIFT: Strengthening GIFT against Statistical Cryptanalysis
